div.head: IV Atr 7.1
div.ab: Si non possint, werę suę culpa sit uel uitę suę, sicut rex uolet, uel eadem lada se innoxient, quam prediximus, quod in ipsa pecunia nil inmundum sciebant, unde suam negotiationem exercuerunt.
Si non possint, werae suae culpa sit vel vitae suae, sicut rex volet, vel eadem lada se innoxient quam praediximus, quod in ipsa pecunia nil immundum sciebant unde suam negotiationem exercuerunt.

If they cannot do so, they shall forfeit their wergeld or their life, as the king shall decide, or they shall clear themselves by the same method as we have specified above, [asserting] that they were unaware that there was anything counterfeit about the money with which they were carrying on their business.

Wenn sie dies nicht können, sei ihr Wergeld oder ihr Leben verwirkt, je wie der König verfügen will, oder sie mögen mit demselben Beweisrecht, das wir oben genannt haben, sich als unschuldig darthun: dass sie [nämlich] an diesem Gelde, womit sie ihren Handel getrieben haben, kein Falsch gewusst hätten.

If they cannot, let their wergild or their life be forfeit, as the king will decide, or let them prove themselves innocent by the same means of proof that we named above: [namely] that they knew of nothing false in the money with which they did their trading.
